pundit.name: Eric Wynalda
pundit.take:
**The Noisemaker's Draft Strategy: Pure Comedy, Mustard Boy's Brazilian Hail Mary, and Why Gunner's Dominance Proves Them All Ungrateful Amateurs**

Watching these so-called "managers" flail around in this fantasy pool has been downright comical, but Rafe—aka "The Noisemaker"—takes the cake with his baffling draft of three teams that didn't even qualify. Did you even read the rulebook, kid, or just pick your FIFA favorites? Mexico against England will be a brutal revelation; the reality is "The Backpass Assassin" Gayden drafted a squad of underachievers who won't be able to find the net with a GPS. Expect Mexico to exploit England's inability to score in high-pressure games and snag a surprise win.

And then we have Zach's "Mustard Boy" approach, relying on Brazil to salvage an otherwise mediocre roster. Brazil versus Norway is less about the players on the pitch and more about Zach's desperate hope that his big-ticket draft choice pays dividends. Brazil will cruise past Norway who won't know what hit them. Meanwhile, Gunner, or "Bubba G," is sitting pretty at the top of the standings because he actually understands how this works. He's picked smart, balanced teams like France and Morocco, which is why he racks up the points while the rest stumble around lost. The standings don't lie, folks: Gunner's the only one here who remotely knows how to play this game.
